title: Song of Songs — Instructions and Commands
content:
Song of Songs — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

22 additional passage records · 25 quoted verse units. Read Song of Songs in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Family, marriage and household · Wisdom, speech and conduct · Work, possessions and stewardship · Historical commissions, journeys and public life

Faith, repentance and allegiance

Uncertain · 2 passage records

Song of Songs 4:8

Record type: Poetic charge or invitation. Source section: A Garden Locked, a Spring Sealed.

Song of Songs 4:8 — Come from Lebanon, bride, come from Lebanon. You will come and pass through from the beginning of faith, from the summit of Senir and Hermon, from lions’ enclosures, from leopards’ mountains.

Context and scope: A charge or invitation in the poem’s dialogue. It is retained as poetic speech, not converted into a general civil or religious law.
